name: Stop handing off. Start shipping
caption:
Stop Handing Off, Start Shipping. The boundary between design and code is blurring fast. Here's how product design workflows are evolving:

Old way: Exporting specs and waiting for the build.
New way: Working in the real codebase and reviewing what ships.

The last mile is design, too. Are you currently editing in the codebase or sticking to standard design handoffs? Drop your setup below.
